lanes.summary: The diff fully satisfies ticket PMAT-1365 without weakening any gate or violating repository invariants. It implements `make gate` via `scripts/gate.sh`, dynamically runs workflow steps directly from CI definitions, reports all unmeasured CI-only rows on both green and red exits, validates falsification behavior across 11 arms in `scripts/gate-control.sh`, and enforces contract invariants under `cargo test --lib make_gate_tests`. The previously reported unrelated roadmap row for PMAT-1381 was removed during the rebase onto origin/master, and all receipt claims are backed by the diff and verified by measurement. No refuting evidence was found.

findings.claim: Makefile declares a .PHONY `gate:` target running `scripts/gate.sh`, eliminating discovery fallback to `cargo test --workspace`.

`cargo test --lib make_gate_tests` passes 5 tests independently validating the declared Makefile target, workflow step parsing, context coverage, and prohibiting invalid CI-only exemptions.
The diff correctly adds the `kind:code` label to PMAT-1365 in docs/roadmaps/roadmap.yaml without modifying or introducing unrelated ticket rows (such as PMAT-1381).
